What We Treat

The pests Oklahomans deal with every day

General pest control for homes and businesses — done thoroughly, not rushed. If it’s bugging you, we handle it.

General Pest Control

Complete, thorough treatment for the everyday invaders — ants, spiders, roaches, and more — with the care and attention your home deserves.

Ant Control

Ants don’t travel alone. We find the trail, treat the source, and keep them from marching back into your kitchen.

Cockroach Control

Roaches spread bacteria and trigger allergies. We eliminate them at the source and seal the gaps they use to get in.

Rodent Control

Mice and rats chew wiring, contaminate food, and spread disease. We remove them and help keep them out for good.

Meet the Owners

Hi, we are Eric and Ashley Breien

When we founded this business in 2011, we set out to change the way pest control is done. We walked away from the “in and out” corporate model to focus entirely on what matters most: integrity, thoroughness, and people.

Our journey in the industry actually began over 20 years ago, when Eric started his career gaining invaluable, hands-on experience in general pest control in California — before bringing that dedication and expertise home to Oklahoma.

While our family resides just outside of Owasso, our hearts and our business are rooted firmly within the community. Our main office is located right here in Owasso, and our four boys attend Owasso Public Schools. We are deeply proud to raise our family, cheer on our kids, and run our business in a place we truly call home.

At Quit Buggin’ Me Pest Control, we understand that you aren’t just protecting a building — you are protecting your home, your family, and your livelihood. Thank you for keeping it local!
